items.source:
However, if the name column is actually null within the result set, the entire property embeddedEntity will be set to null according to the onEmpty of @Embedded, which nulls objects when all nested properties are null.
Opposite to this behavior USE_EMPTY tries to create a new instance using either a default constructor or one that accepts nullable parameter values from the result set.
items.translation:
然而，如果结果集中的 `name` 列实际上为 `null`，则整个属性 `embeddedEntity` 将根据 `@Embedded` 的 `onEmpty` 设置为 null，该选项会在所有嵌套属性均为 null 时将对象置为 null。
与这种行为相反，`USE_EMPTY` 尝试使用默认构造函数或接受来自结果集的可为空参数值的构造函数来创建新实例。

items.source: The short Java class name is mapped to the table name in the following manner. The com.bigbank.SavingsAccount class maps to the SAVINGS_ACCOUNT table name. The same name mapping is applied for mapping fields to column names. For example, the firstName field maps to the FIRST_NAME column. You can control this mapping by providing a custom NamingStrategy. See Mapping Configuration for more detail. Table and column names that are derived from property or class names are used in SQL statements with quotes by default. You can control this behavior by setting JdbcMappingContext.setForceQuote(false), or use JdbcMappingContext.forPlainIdentifiers() to create a context with plain (unquoted) identifiers.
items.translation: 短 Java 类名按以下方式映射到表名。 com.bigbank.SavingsAccount 类映射到 SAVINGS_ACCOUNT 表名。 相同的名称映射规则也用于将字段映射到列名。 例如，firstName 字段映射到 FIRST_NAME 列。 您可以通过提供自定义的 NamingStrategy 来控制此映射。 有关更多详细信息，请参阅映射配置。 默认情况下，从属性名或类名派生的表和列名在 SQL 语句中使用引号。 您可以通过设置 JdbcMappingContext.setForceQuote(false) 来控制此行为，或使用 JdbcMappingContext.forPlainIdentifiers() 创建一个具有普通（未加引号）标识符的上下文。

items.source: For List, Set, and Map naming of the back reference can be controlled by implementing NamingStrategy.getReverseColumnName(RelationalPersistentEntity<?> owner) and NamingStrategy.getKeyColumn(RelationalPersistentProperty property), respectively. Alternatively you may annotate the attribute with @MappedCollection(idColumn="your_column_name", keyColumn="your_key_column_name"). Specifying a key column for a Set has no effect.
items.translation: 对于 ``、`` 和 ``，可以通过分别实现 `NamingStrategy.getReverseColumnName(RelationalPersistentEntity owner)` 和 `NamingStrategy.getKeyColumn(RelationalPersistentProperty property)` 来控制反向引用的命名。 或者，您可以使用注解 `@MappedCollection(idColumn="your_column_name", keyColumn="your_key_column_name")` 来标注该属性。 为 `` 指定键列无效。

items.source: @Embedded: a property with this annotation will be mapped to the table of the parent entity, instead of a separate table. Allows to specify if the resulting columns should have a common prefix. If all columns resulting from such an entity are null either the annotated entity will be null or empty, i.e. all of its properties will be null, depending on the value of @Embedded.onEmpty() May be combined with @Id to form a composite id.
items.translation: @Embedded：带有此注解的属性将被映射到父实体所在的表，而不是单独的表。 允许指定生成的列是否应具有公共前缀。 如果由该实体生成的所有列均为 null，则根据 @Embedded.onEmpty() 的值，该注解实体将变为 null 或空（即其所有属性均为 null）。 可与 @Id 组合使用以形成复合主键。

items.source: If the referenced id is an @Embedded id, the back reference consists of multiple columns, each named by a concatenation of <table-name> + _ + <column-name>. E.g. the back reference to a Person entity, with a composite id with the properties firstName and lastName will consist of the two columns PERSON_FIRST_NAME and PERSON_LAST_NAME.
items.translation: 如果引用的 ID 是 `@Embedded` ID，则回引用由多个列组成，每个列的名称由 `` + `_` + `` 拼接而成。例如，对于具有复合 ID 且属性为 `firstName` 和 `lastName` 的 `Person` 实体，其回引用将由两个列 `PERSON_FIRST_NAME` 和 `PERSON_LAST_NAME` 组成。

items.source: The MappedCollection annotation can be used on Sets, Lists, and Maps (one-to-many relationships). The idColumn element of the annotation provides a custom name for the foreign key column referencing the id column in the other table. It also customizes the back-reference column name for single-entity (one-to-one) references. In the following example the corresponding table for the MySubEntity class has a NAME column, and the CUSTOM_MY_ENTITY_ID_COLUMN_NAME column of the MyEntity id for relationship reasons:
items.translation: `MappedCollection` 注解可用于 Set、List 和 Map（一对多关系）。该注解的 `idColumn` 元素可为引用另一表中 id 列的外键列指定自定义名称。它还可用于自定义单实体（一对一）引用的反向引用列名称。在以下示例中，与 `MySubEntity` 类对应的表包含一个 `NAME` 列，而 `MyEntity` 的 `CUSTOM_MY_ENTITY_ID_COLUMN_NAME` 列则因关系原因被用作 id：

items.source: When using List and Map you must have an additional column for the position of a dataset in the List or the key value of the entity in the Map. This additional column name may be customized with the keyColumn Element of the MappedCollection annotation:
items.translation: 在使用List和Map时，必须额外添加一列，用于表示数据集在List中的位置或实体在Map中的键值。 此附加列的名称可以通过MappedCollection注解的keyColumn元素进行自定义：

items.source: By convention, Spring Data applies a NamingStrategy to determine table, column, and schema names defaulting to snake case. An object property named firstName becomes first_name. You can tweak that by providing a NamingStrategy in your application context.
items.translation: 按照约定，Spring Data 会应用一个 NamingStrategy 来确定表、列和模式名称，默认采用 蛇形命名法。 名为 firstName 的对象属性将变为 first_name。 您可以通过在应用程序上下文中提供一个 NamingStrategy 来调整此行为。

items.source: When the column naming strategy does not match your database column names, you can override the column name with the Column annotation. The element value of this annotation provides the custom column name. The following example maps the name property of the MyEntity class to the CUSTOM_COLUMN_NAME column in the database:
items.translation: 当列命名策略与数据库列名不匹配时，您可以使用 Column 注解覆盖列名。 该注解的 value 元素提供自定义列名。 以下示例将 MyEntity 类的 name 属性映射到数据库中的 CUSTOM_COLUMN_NAME 列：

items.source: Embedded entities are used to have value objects in your java data model, even if there is only one table in your database. In the following example you see, that MyEntity is mapped with the @Embedded annotation. The consequence of this is, that in the database a table my_entity with the two columns id and name (from the EmbeddedEntity class) is expected.
items.translation: 嵌入式实体用于在 Java 数据模型中包含值对象，即使您的数据库中只有一个表。 在以下示例中可以看到，MyEntity 使用了 @Embedded 注解进行映射。 其结果是，数据库中将期望存在一个名为 my_entity 的表，该表包含两列：id 和 name（来自 EmbeddedEntity 类）。

items.source: @MappedCollection: Allows for configuration how a collection, or a single nested entity gets mapped. idColumn specifies the column used for referencing the parent entities primary key. keyColumn specifies the column used to store the index of a List or the key of a Map.
items.translation: ：允许配置集合或单个嵌套实体的映射方式。idColumn 指定用于引用父实体主键的列。keyColumn 指定用于存储 List 索引或 Map 键的列。

items.source: @Version: Applied at field level is used for optimistic locking and checked for modification on save operations. A value of null for wrapper types (or zero for primitive types) marks the entity as new. The initially stored value is zero for wrapper types (one for primitive types). The version gets incremented automatically on every update.
items.translation: @Version：在字段级别应用，用于乐观锁，并在保存操作时检查修改。 对于包装类型，值为 null（或对于基本类型为 zero）表示实体为新实体。 初始存储的值对于包装类型为 zero（对于基本类型为 one）。 每次更新时版本号会自动递增。

items.source: When the table naming strategy does not match your database table names, you can override the table name with the Table annotation. The element value of this annotation provides the custom table name. The following example maps the MyEntity class to the CUSTOM_TABLE_NAME table in the database:
items.translation: 当表命名策略与您的数据库表名不匹配时，您可以使用 Table 注解来覆盖表名。 该注解的 value 元素提供自定义表名。 以下示例将 MyEntity 类映射到数据库中的 CUSTOM_TABLE_NAME 表：

items.source: Make use of the shortcuts @Embedded.Nullable & @Embedded.Empty for @Embedded(onEmpty = USE_NULL) and @Embedded(onEmpty = USE_EMPTY) to reduce verbosity and simultaneously set JSR-305 @javax.annotation.Nonnull accordingly.
items.translation: 使用快捷方式@Embedded.Nullable和@Embedded.Empty来替代@Embedded(onEmpty = USE_NULL)和@Embedded(onEmpty = USE_EMPTY)，以减少冗长性，同时相应地设置 JSR-305 注解@javax.annotation.Nonnull。

items.source: There are a couple of things to notice here: Boolean and String are both simple types hence Spring Data requires a hint in which direction this converter should apply (reading or writing). By annotating this converter with @WritingConverter you instruct Spring Data to write every Boolean property as String in the database.
items.translation: 这里有几点需要注意：Boolean和String都是简单类型，因此Spring Data需要提示该转换器应朝哪个方向应用（读取或写入）。通过用@WritingConverter注解此转换器，您指示Spring Data将每个Boolean属性以String形式写入数据库。

items.source: There are a couple of things to notice here: String and Boolean are both simple types hence Spring Data requires a hint in which direction this converter should apply (reading or writing). By annotating this converter with @ReadingConverter you instruct Spring Data to convert every String value from the database that should be assigned to a Boolean property.
items.translation: 这里有几点需要注意：String 和 Boolean 都是简单类型，因此 Spring Data 需要提示该转换器的应用方向（读取或写入）。通过用 @ReadingConverter 注解此转换器，您指示 Spring Data 将数据库中应赋值给 Boolean 属性的每个 String 值进行转换。

items.source: All primitive types and their boxed types (int, float, Integer, Float, and so on)
items.translation: 所有基本类型及其对应的包装类型（int、float、Integer、Float 等）

items.source: Value conversion uses JdbcValue to enrich values propagated to JDBC operations with a java.sql.Types type. Register a custom write converter if you need to specify a JDBC-specific type instead of using type derivation. This converter should convert the value to JdbcValue which has a field for the value and for the actual JDBCType.
items.translation: 值转换使用 `JdbcValue` 来丰富传播到 JDBC 操作的值，并添加一个 `java.sql.Types` 类型。如果您需要指定特定的 JDBC 类型而不是使用类型推导，请注册自定义写入转换器。该转换器应将值转换为 `JdbcValue`，其中包含用于值的字段和实际的 `JDBCType` 字段。

items.source: Rich mapping support is provided by the MappingJdbcConverter. MappingJdbcConverter has a rich metadata model that allows mapping domain objects to a data row. The mapping metadata model is populated by using annotations on your domain objects. However, the infrastructure is not limited to using annotations as the only source of metadata information. The MappingJdbcConverter also lets you map objects to rows without providing any additional metadata, by following a set of conventions.
items.translation: MappingJdbcConverter 提供了丰富的映射支持。MappingJdbcConverter 拥有完善的元数据模型，能够将领域对象映射到数据行。该映射元数据模型通过您在领域对象上使用的注解进行填充。然而，基础设施并不局限于仅使用注解作为元数据的唯一来源。MappingJdbcConverter 还允许您遵循一系列约定，在无需提供任何额外元数据的情况下将对象映射到行。

items.source: References to other entities. They are considered a one-to-one relationship, or an embedded type. It is optional for one-to-one relationship entities to have an id attribute. The table of the referenced entity is expected to have an additional column with a name based on the referencing entity see Back References. Embedded entities do not need an id. If one is present it gets mapped as a normal attribute without any special meaning.
items.translation: 对其他实体的引用。 它们被视为一对一关系或嵌入类型。 对于一对一关系的实体，id 属性是可选的。 预期被引用实体的表将包含一个额外列，其名称基于引用实体，参见 反向引用。 嵌入实体不需要 id。 如果存在，它将被映射为普通属性，没有任何特殊含义。

items.source: Map<simple type, some entity> is considered a qualified one-to-many relationship. The table of the referenced entity is expected to have two additional columns: One named based on the referencing entity for the foreign key (see Back References) and one with the same name and an additional _key suffix for the map key.
items.translation: Map<简单类型，某些实体> 被视为合格的单向一对多关系。 预期被引用实体的表将包含两个额外的列：一列基于引用实体命名以表示外键（参见回引），另一列名称相同但附加 _key 后缀用于映射键。

items.source: @Value: This annotation is part of the Spring Framework. Within the mapping framework it can be applied to constructor arguments. This lets you use a Spring Expression Language statement to transform a key’s value retrieved in the database before it is used to construct a domain object. In order to reference a column of a given row one has to use expressions like: @Value("#root.myProperty") where root refers to the root of the given Row.
items.translation: @Value：此注解属于 Spring 框架。在映射框架中，它可以应用于构造函数参数。这使得您能够在使用检索到的数据库键值构建领域对象之前，使用 Spring 表达式语言语句对其进行转换。若要引用给定行中的某一列，需使用类似 @Value("#root.myProperty") 的表达式，其中 root 指代给定 Row 的根节点。

items.source: @Column: Applied at the field level to describe the name of the column as it is represented in the row, letting the name be different from the field name of the class. Names specified with a @Column annotation are quoted when forceQuote is enabled (default). For most databases, quoting means that these names are case-sensitive. It also means that you can use special characters in these names. However, this is not recommended, since it may cause problems with other tools.
items.translation: @Column：应用于字段级别，用于描述行中列的名称，使其可以与类的字段名不同。 当启用 forceQuote（默认情况下）时，使用 @Column 注解指定的名称会被加引号。 对于大多数数据库而言，加引号意味着这些名称是区分大小写的。 这也意味着您可以在这些名称中使用特殊字符。 然而，这不推荐，因为这可能会与其他工具产生问题。

items.source: If you have n-1 or n-m references, you are, by definition, dealing with two separate aggregates. References between those may be encoded as simple id values, which map properly with Spring Data JDBC. A better way to encode these, is to make them instances of AggregateReference. An AggregateReference is a wrapper around an id value which marks that value as a reference to a different aggregate. Also, the type of that aggregate is encoded in a type parameter.
items.translation: 如果您有 n-1 或 n-m 个引用，根据定义，您正在处理两个独立的聚合。这些聚合之间的引用可以编码为简单的 `id` 值，这些值能够与 Spring Data JDBC 正确映射。更好的编码方式是将它们实例化为 `AggregateReference`。AggregateReference 是一个包装器，它封装了一个 id 值，并标记该值为对另一个聚合的引用。此外，该聚合的类型也通过类型参数进行编码。

items.source: Alternatively you may choose to have them named by the entity name of the referencing entity ignoring @Table annotations. You activate this behaviour by calling setForeignKeyNaming(ForeignKeyNaming.IGNORE_RENAMING) on the DefaultNamingStrategy.
items.translation: 或者，您可以选择使用引用实体的实体名称来命名它们，而忽略 `@Table` 注解。 您可以通过在 `DefaultNamingStrategy` 上调用 `setForeignKeyNaming(ForeignKeyNaming.IGNORE_RENAMING)` 来激活此行为。

items.source: For List and Map references an additional column is required for holding the list index or map key. It is based on the foreign key column with an additional _KEY suffix.
items.translation: 对于 `List` 和 `Map` 引用，需要额外添加一列用于存储列表索引或映射键。该列基于外键列，并附加了 `_KEY` 后缀。

items.source: Embedded entities containing a Collection or a Map will always be considered non-empty since they will at least contain the empty collection or map. Such an entity will therefore never be null even when using @Embedded(onEmpty = USE_NULL).
items.translation: 包含 `Collection` 或 `Map` 的嵌入式实体始终被视为非空，因为它们至少会包含一个空集合或映射。因此，即使在使用 `@Embedded(onEmpty = USE_NULL)` 时，此类实体也永远不会为 `null`。

items.source: If the Java type has a property whose name matches the given field of the input row, then its property information is used to select the appropriate constructor parameter to which to pass the input field value. This works only if the parameter name information is present in the Java .class files, which you can achieve by compiling the source with debug information or using the -parameters command-line switch for javac in Java 8.
items.translation: 如果 Java 类型具有与输入行给定字段名称匹配的属性，则使用其属性信息来选择要传递输入字段值的适当构造函数参数。 此功能仅在 Java `.class` 文件中存在参数名信息时才能生效，您可以通过在编译源代码时包含调试信息，或在 Java 8 中使用 `javac` 的 `-parameters` 命令行开关来实现这一点。

items.source: If you want to rely on Spring Boot to bootstrap Spring Data JDBC, but still want to override certain aspects of the configuration, you may want to expose beans of that type. For custom conversions you may e.g. choose to register a bean of type JdbcCustomConversions that will be picked up by the Boot infrastructure. To learn more about this please make sure to read the Spring Boot Reference Documentation.
items.translation: 如果您希望依赖 Spring Boot 来引导 Spring Data JDBC，但仍想覆盖某些配置方面，您可能需要暴露相应类型的 Bean。 对于自定义转换，您可以选择注册一个类型为 JdbcCustomConversions 的 Bean，该 Bean 将被启动基础设施自动拾取。 如需了解更多相关信息，请务必阅读 Spring Boot 参考文档。

items.source: Set<some entity> is considered a one-to-many relationship. The table of the referenced entity is expected to have an additional column with a name based on the referencing entity see Back References.
items.translation: Set<some entity> 被视为一对多关系。 预期被引用实体的表将包含一个额外列，其名称基于引用实体，参见反向引用。

items.source: List<some entity> is mapped as a Map<Integer, some entity>. The same additional columns are expected and the names used can be customized in the same way.
items.translation:
<List<某些实体>>被映射为<Map<Integer, 某些实体>>。  
预期包含相同的附加列，且列名可按相同方式自定义。

items.source: @Id: Applied at the field level to mark the primary key. It may be combined with @Embedded to form a composite id.
items.translation: @Id：应用于字段级别，用于标记主键。 它可以与 @Embedded 结合使用以形成复合主键。

items.source: If you need a value object multiple times in an entity, this can be achieved with the optional prefix element of the @Embedded annotation. This element represents a prefix and is prepended to each column name in the embedded object.
items.translation: 如果在实体中需要多次使用值对象，可以通过 `@Embedded` 注解的可选 `prefix` 元素来实现。该元素表示一个前缀，并将其附加到嵌入对象的每个列名之前。

items.source: The identifier property can be annotated with @Embedded allowing to use composite ids. The full embedded entity is considered the id, and therefore the check for determining if an aggregate is considered a new aggregate requiring an insert or an existing one, asking for an update is based on that entity, not its elements. Most use cases will require a custom BeforeConvertCallback to set the id for new aggregate.
items.translation: 标识符属性可以标注为 `@Embedded` 以支持复合主键。完整的嵌入实体被视为标识符，因此用于判断聚合根是新聚合（需要插入）还是已存在聚合（需要更新）的检查基于该实体本身，而非其元素。大多数使用场景都需要自定义一个 `BeforeConvertCallback` 来为新聚合设置标识符。

items.source: This section describes the features of the MappingJdbcConverter, including how to use conventions for mapping objects to rows and how to override those conventions with annotation-based mapping metadata.
items.translation: 本节介绍 `MappingJdbcConverter` 的功能，包括如何使用约定将对象映射到行，以及如何通过基于注解的映射元数据覆盖这些约定。

items.source: Read on the basics about Object Mapping Fundamentals before continuing with this chapter.
items.translation: 继续阅读对象映射基础，然后再继续本章内容。

items.source: MappingJdbcConverter has a few conventions for mapping objects to rows when no additional mapping metadata is provided. The conventions are:
items.translation: 当未提供额外的映射元数据时，`MappingJdbcConverter` 在将对象映射为行时遵循一些约定。这些约定如下：

items.source: The converter uses any Spring Converters registered with CustomConversions to override the default mapping of object properties to row columns and values.
items.translation: 转换器使用通过CustomConversions注册的任意 Spring 转换器，以覆盖对象属性到行列和值的默认映射。

items.source: The fields of an object are used to convert to and from columns in the row. Public JavaBean properties are not used.
items.translation: 对象的字段用于在行中的列之间进行转换。 不使用公共的 `JavaBean` 属性。

items.source: If you have a single non-zero-argument constructor whose constructor argument names match top-level column names of the row, that constructor is used. Otherwise, the zero-argument constructor is used. If there is more than one non-zero-argument constructor, an exception is thrown. Refer to Object Creation for further details.
items.translation: 如果存在一个具有单个非零参数的构造函数，且该构造函数的参数名称与行的顶级列名匹配，则使用该构造函数。否则，使用无参构造函数。如果存在多个具有非零参数的构造函数，将抛出异常。有关更多详细信息，请参阅对象创建。

items.source: Types for which you registered suitable custom converters.
items.translation: 已注册了合适的自定义转换器的类型。

items.source: The RelationalConverter can use metadata to drive the mapping of objects to rows. The following annotations are available:
items.translation: RelationalConverter 可以使用元数据来驱动对象到行的映射。 以下注解可用：

items.source: @InsertOnlyProperty: Marks a property as only to be written during insert. Such a property on an aggregate root will only be written once and never updated. Note that on a nested entity, all save operations result in an insert therefore this annotation has no effect on properties of nested entities.
items.translation: @InsertOnlyProperty：标记该属性仅在插入时写入。在聚合根上的此类属性将仅被写入一次，且永远不会被更新。请注意，对于嵌套实体，所有保存操作均被视为插入，因此该注解对嵌套实体的属性无效。

items.source: @Sequence: specify a database sequence for generating values for the annotated property.
items.translation: @Sequence：指定用于为已注解属性生成值的数据库序列。

items.source: @Table: Applied at the class level to indicate this class is a candidate for mapping to the database. You can specify the name of the table where the database is stored.
items.translation: @Table：在类级别应用，表示该类是数据库映射的候选者。您可以指定存储该表的数据库名称。

items.source: @Transient: By default, all fields are mapped to the row. This annotation excludes the field where it is applied from being stored in the database. Transient properties cannot be used within a persistence constructor as the converter cannot materialize a value for the constructor argument.
items.translation: @Transient：默认情况下，所有字段都会映射到行中。此注解会排除应用该注解的字段不被存储到数据库中。瞬态属性不能在持久化构造函数中使用，因为转换器无法为构造函数参数生成值。

items.source: @PersistenceCreator: Marks a given constructor or static factory method — even a package protected one — to use when instantiating the object from the database. Constructor arguments are mapped by name to the values in the retrieved row.
items.translation:
@PersistenceCreator：标记一个给定的构造函数或静态工厂方法（即使是包级私有的），用于从数据库实例化对象。  
构造函数的参数通过名称映射到检索到的行中的值。

items.source: See Optimistic Locking for further reference.
items.translation: 有关更多参考，请参见乐观锁。

items.source: The mapping metadata infrastructure is defined in the separate spring-data-commons project that is technology-agnostic. Specific subclasses are used in the JDBC support to support annotation based metadata. Other strategies can also be put in place (if there is demand).
items.translation: 映射元数据基础设施定义在独立的、与具体技术无关的 spring-data-commons 项目中。JDBC 支持使用特定的子类来支持基于注解的元数据。其他策略也可以根据需要被引入（如果有需求的话）。

items.source: If you want a completely different way of naming these back references you may implement NamingStrategy.getReverseColumnName(RelationalPersistentEntity<?> owner) in a way that fits your needs.
items.translation: 如果您希望以完全不同的方式命名这些反向引用，可以在您的实现中自定义NamingStrategy.getReverseColumnName(RelationalPersistentEntity<?> owner)方法，使其符合您的需求。

items.source: You should not include attributes in your entities to hold the actual value of a back reference, nor of the key column of maps or lists. If you want these values to be available in your domain model we recommend to do this in an AfterConvertCallback and store the values in transient values.
items.translation: 您不应在实体中使用属性来存储反向引用的实际值，也不应存储映射或列表的主键列。 如果您希望这些值在领域模型中可用，我们建议在AfterConvertCallback中执行此操作，并将这些值存储在瞬态属性中。

items.source: You may use Spring Data’s SpEL support to dynamically create the table name. Once generated the table name will be cached, so it is dynamic per mapping context only.
items.translation: 您可以使用Spring Data 的 SpEL 支持来动态创建表名。生成后的表名会被缓存，因此仅在映射上下文中是动态的。

items.source: You may use Spring Data’s SpEL support to dynamically create column names. Once generated the names will be cached, so it is dynamic per mapping context only.
items.translation: 您可以使用Spring Data 的 SpEL 支持来动态创建列名。生成的名称会被缓存，因此仅在映射上下文中是动态的。

items.source: Attributes annotated with @ReadOnlyProperty will not be written to the database by Spring Data, but they will be read when an entity gets loaded.
items.translation: 使用 @ReadOnlyProperty 注解的属性不会被 Spring Data 写入数据库，但在加载实体时会被读取。

items.source: Attributes annotated with @InsertOnlyProperty will only be written to the database by Spring Data during insert operations. For updates these properties will be ignored.
items.translation: 使用 @InsertOnlyProperty 注解的属性，Spring Data 仅在插入操作时将其写入数据库。对于更新操作，这些属性将被忽略。

items.source: @InsertOnlyProperty is only supported for the aggregate root.
items.translation: @InsertOnlyProperty 仅支持聚合根。

items.source: The mapping subsystem allows the customization of the object construction by annotating a constructor with the @PersistenceConstructor annotation. The values to be used for the constructor parameters are resolved in the following way:
items.translation: 映射子系统允许通过用@PersistenceConstructor注解构造函数来自定义对象构建。 用于解析构造函数参数的值的方式如下：

items.source: If a parameter is annotated with the @Value annotation, the given expression is evaluated, and the result is used as the parameter value.
items.translation: 如果参数被标注了 `@Value` 注解，则会评估给定的表达式，并将结果用作该参数的值。

items.source: Otherwise, a MappingException is thrown to indicate that the given constructor parameter could not be bound.
items.translation: 否则，将抛出MappingException以指示无法绑定给定的构造函数参数。

items.source: The properties of the following types are currently supported:
items.translation: 当前支持以下类型的属性：

items.source: Enums get mapped to their names.
items.translation: 枚举会被映射为其名称。

items.source: Arrays and Collections of the types mentioned above can be mapped to columns of array type if your database supports that.
items.translation: 如果数据库支持，上述类型的数组和集合可以映射为数组类型的列。

items.source: Anything your database driver accepts.
items.translation: 数据库驱动程序接受的任何内容。

items.source:
The handling of referenced entities is limited.
This is based on the idea of aggregate roots as described above.
If you reference another entity, that entity is, by definition, part of your aggregate.
So, if you remove the reference, the previously referenced entity gets deleted.
This also means references are 1-1 or 1-n, but not n-1 or n-m.
items.translation:
引用实体的处理受到限制。
这是基于上述描述的聚合根概念。
如果您引用另一个实体，那么根据定义，该实体即属于您的聚合部分。
因此，如果移除引用，先前被引用的实体将被删除。
这也意味着引用关系只能是 1-1 或 1-n，而不能是 n-1 或 n-m。

items.source:
All references in an aggregate result in a foreign key relationship in the opposite direction in the database.
By default, the name of the foreign key column is the table name of the referencing entity.
items.translation:
聚合中的所有引用都会在数据库中形成反向的外键关系。  
默认情况下，外键列的名称为引用实体的表名。

items.source: Details of table creation depend on the used database.
items.translation: 表创建的具体细节取决于所使用的数据库。

items.source:
Spring Data will not automatically reload an entity after writing it.
Therefore, you have to reload it explicitly if you want to see data that was generated in the database for such columns.
items.translation: Spring Data 在写入实体后不会自动重新加载该实体。因此，如果您希望查看数据库中为这些列生成的数据，必须显式地重新加载该实体。

items.source:
If the annotated attribute is an entity or collection of entities, it is represented by one or more separate rows in separate tables.
Spring Data will not perform any insert, delete or update for these rows.
items.translation:
如果注释的属性是实体或实体集合，则它由不同表中的一个或多个独立行表示。  
Spring Data 不会对这些行执行任何插入、删除或更新操作。

items.source:
Spring Data allows registration of custom converters to influence how values are mapped in the database.
Currently, converters are only applied on property-level, i.e. you can only convert single values in your domain to single values in the database and back.
Conversion between complex objects and multiple columns isn’t supported.
items.translation:
Spring Data 允许注册自定义转换器，以影响数据库中的值映射方式。  
目前，转换器仅在属性级别应用，即您只能将领域模型中的单个值转换为数据库中的单个值，反之亦然。  
不支持在复杂对象与多个列之间进行转换。

items.source: In previous versions of Spring Data JDBC it was recommended to directly overwrite AbstractJdbcConfiguration.jdbcCustomConversions(). This is no longer necessary or even recommended, since that method assembles conversions intended for all databases, conversions registered by the JdbcDialect used and conversions registered by the user. If you are migrating from an older version of Spring Data JDBC and have AbstractJdbcConfiguration.jdbcCustomConversions() overwritten conversions from your JdbcDialect will not get registered.
items.translation: 在 Spring Data JDBC 的早期版本中，建议直接覆盖 AbstractJdbcConfiguration.jdbcCustomConversions()。 现在已不再需要这样做，甚至不推荐，因为该方法会组装适用于所有数据库的转换、由所使用的 JdbcDialect 注册的转换以及用户注册的转换。 如果您是从 Spring Data JDBC 的旧版本迁移而来并覆盖了 AbstractJdbcConfiguration.jdbcCustomConversions()，则您的 JdbcDialect 中的转换将无法注册。
